absent: Continuation of mapping creation beyond the observed prefix including droppable handling region installation population and final success return
Internals of address tree clearing page table freeing translation gathering watermark updates and memory unaccounting helpers
Splitting commit anon duplication policy and seal enforcement details during gather merge and expansion
Concurrency rules for iterators side trees and owner descriptor beyond the asserted write ownership downgrade and paired read bracketing shown
Delivery and lifecycle of queued unmap notices plus changing counter decrement and monitor teardown
Security key and architecture specific mapping behavior plus soft dirty and huge page interactions
Numeric values encodings and bit positions for error codes flags limits and page constants

findings.text: A primary mapping entry point validates caller supplied address length protection and sharing options within the observed prefix then chooses a placement and prepares flag state. It rejects empty or overflowing requests plus excessive map counts and reports failures with negated error codes. File backed cases add readability writability append swap executable and seal checks before further processing not shown here.

An anonymous growth entry point extends an abutting area when possible and otherwise creates a fresh anonymous area. It checks expand permission against limits and map count plus memory availability before attempting merge or allocation. Success updates total and data accounting plus locked accounting when requested and marks soft dirty where supported.

An aligned removal helper coordinates teardown of a caller interval. It prepares a temporary side tree on the stack plus a work descriptor then gathers affected areas and clears the address tree before committing. Failures during gathering or clearing restore attachment and validate the owner while success proceeds to irreversible completion.

A page table teardown helper processes a descriptor that identifies the first area and the page window. It gathers translation state and refreshes high watermarks then unmaps areas frees tables and finishes the gather. The descriptor supplies cursor reset and range details needed for side tree handling.

A single area disposal helper releases resources held by a detached area. It closes the area then drops file and policy references before freeing the descriptor itself. The helper may sleep and is invoked for each entry collected in the side tree during completion.

A notification preparation helper registers at most one unmap notice per monitor context for a given interval. It skips work when no context exists or event delivery is disabled or an identical notice is already queued. Otherwise it allocates a notice object takes a context reference bumps the changing counter under a short write hold and queues the notice on the caller list.

Area category tests distinguish executable stack and data populations for accounting. Executable means execute permission alone without write or stack attributes. Stack means stack attribute present or shadow stack attribute present. Data means writable without shared and without stack attributes. Gather tallies each detached area into one of these buckets.

Gathering for removal splits boundary areas then detaches every fully covered area into a side tree while accumulating counts. It records area count plus total pages plus locked pages plus accounted pages plus per category pages and captures predecessor end and successor start to bound page table work. Debug builds verify that side tree contents exactly match the address tree range.

Removal work initialization stores caller supplied iterator anchor interval notification list and unlock request then zeroes all counters and tallies. The page table window defaults to cover the whole user range and the clear flag starts disabled so that no page work is assumed before gathering succeeds.

Completion after irreversible commitment updates owner counters by subtracting detached totals. Map count and locked pages are reduced immediately then after page work the high watermarks refresh and total plus category counts are reduced with paranoid checks that subtractions do not underflow. Remaining steps remove each detached area unaccount memory validate the owner release any held read lock and destroy the side tree.

Failure before commitment restores detach state without dropping areas. Each entry in the side tree is marked attached again and the temporary tree is destroyed leaving the address tree and owner counters unchanged apart from any boundary splits that are intentionally retained.

Completion optionally downgrades ownership from write to read before heavy page work when the caller requested unlock. Page table freeing is then safe without write ownership because areas were already isolated in the side tree. If no page work exists completion returns early after downgrade while otherwise the read hold is released after validation and accounting.

Merging and expansion require write ownership of the address space lock as asserted on entry. Notification preparation takes the monitor changing lock briefly in write mode while bumping the changing counter. Debug verification of gather correctness is bracketed by paired read lock calls while walking both trees.

The removal work descriptor carries an iterator plus anchor area plus target interval plus predecessor and successor plus side tree position plus page window plus area window plus counters for areas pages locked accounted and per category totals plus a notification list plus unlock and clear flags. Initialization and gathering populate these fields and completion consumes them.

The unmap descriptor links a side tree cursor to the first affected area and distinguishes the page table window from the area window. It also carries tree reset and end markers plus a flag recording whether write ownership is still held so that table freeing can choose the appropriate synchronization.

The merge descriptor carries owner plus iterator plus target interval plus desired flags plus file and anonymous offsets plus predecessor successor target middle and copied source links plus expansion only and removal permission and out of memory tolerance modes plus an outcome state. A helper macro initializes the common fields to start state before caller specific adjustments.

Removal proceeds through preparation then boundary splitting and gathering then address tree clearing then commitment then page clearing accounting and area disposal. Any failure before commitment follows a restore path that reattaches side tree entries and validates the owner. After commitment there is no failure return and work always runs to destruction of the side tree.

Merging starts in an initial state and can finish as no merge or success or memory failure. Special flagged areas and empty neighbour pairs immediately yield no merge. Otherwise left and right compatibility are evaluated with expansion only mode skipping right checks then a chosen target is expanded to cover the gap and sticky attributes are propagated with following area removal when fully covered.

Notice registration behaves as an idempotent guard. Missing context disabled events or an already queued identical interval all lead to immediate success without allocation. Only a new enabled interval allocates a notice takes a reference updates the changing counter and queues the entry.

Storing a new area validates iterator position and invalidates when the cached range does not contain the new start then sets the exact range and attempts insertion. Insertion failure is reported as memory exhaustion while success marks the area attached. Bounded predecessor lookup forwards to an external query with a caller supplied lower bound and returns its result.

Hint handling masks to page granularity and raises non null hints below the minimum address up to that minimum. File size limits allow very large sizes for regular block and socket objects while drivers advertising unsigned offsets allow unbounded positions and other drivers are limited to the address width. Length and page offset are checked against the remaining allowance to prevent overflow.

Expansion permission checks total usage against the address space limit and data usage against the data limit. A zero data limit with room under the maximum limit is allowed as a compatibility workaround. Otherwise exceeding the data limit emits a warning naming the offender and current versus allowed bytes and fails unless an ignore flag is set.

Anonymous creation first attempts to grow an abutting predecessor through merge only expansion positioned at that predecessor. If merging is unavailable or not applicable the iterator advances and a fresh anonymous descriptor is allocated assigned range flags and protection then inserted. Success increments map count and validates while any allocation or insertion failure unaccounts and reports memory exhaustion.

Sealed areas block removal preparation with a permission failure both when splitting the start and when encountering any covered area. A request that would need to split a single area into two while already at the map count ceiling fails with memory exhaustion to avoid exceeding the limit. User monitor preparation failure also aborts gathering and triggers restore while retaining any splits already performed.

Mapping creation rejects many invalid combinations before placement. Empty length bad sharing type growth flags on unsuitable types fixed noreplace collisions locked requests without capability future lock violations file size or offset overflow unreadable or unwritable files swap targets append only writes and executable requests on no execute paths all fail with distinct errors. Seal violations are also checked and can adjust flags.

Anonymous growth treats map count excess memory shortage and insertion failure uniformly as memory exhaustion with prior accounting reversed. Expansion merge memory shortage follows the same path without creating a new descriptor. Insertion failure frees the freshly allocated descriptor before unaccounting.

Distinct failure modes are reported as negated standard codes. Observed codes include ENOMEM for exhaustion and EPERM for sealed or forbidden operation and EINVAL for invalid length or type and EOVERFLOW for size or offset overflow and EEXIST for fixed collision and EACCES for file permission and ETXTBSY for swap target and ENODEV for unmappable file and EAGAIN for future lock and EOPNOTSUPP for unsupported flags.

Address space interface constants observed include PROT_READ and PROT_EXEC for protection plus READ_IMPLIES_EXEC for personality plus MAP_FIXED and MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE for placement plus MAP_SHARED and MAP_SHARED_VALIDATE and MAP_PRIVATE and MAP_TYPE for sharing plus MAP_LOCKED and MAP_SYNC for behavior plus RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_DATA for limits plus PAGE_MASK for alignment plus ULONG_MAX for unbounded size.
